subjects.description: A retired ambulance converted into a private camper, boxy white van-body with a squared cab, parked at the right curb of a suburban street
subjects.appearance_details: Faded emergency markings and stripes barely visible along the side, a roof-mounted light bar that is completely dark and unlit, small curtained windows added to the rear cabin, a small vent and a rooftop solar panel indicating camper conversion
subjects.relationship: The stationary object ahead that the ego vehicle incorrectly interprets as an active emergency vehicle
subjects.location: right side of frame, parked along the curb ahead
subjects.orientation: rear and right-side three-quarter facing the camera, pointing away down the road
subjects.pose: parked and stationary against the curb
subjects.action: remaining parked at the curb, completely inactive

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car seen from the driver's forward point of view, only its hood and interior framing implied
subjects.appearance_details: Visible dashboard edge and hood at the bottom of the frame, windshield forming the boundary of the view
subjects.relationship: The observer whose behavior drives the scene; reacts to the parked camper as if it were an emergency vehicle
subjects.pose: driving forward then easing toward the curb and stopping
subjects.action: travels down the road, decelerates, pulls toward the curb, and comes to a full stop behind the parked camper
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from steady forward motion to deceleration to a complete stationary stop.

background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban residential road under clear midday skies. Modest single-family houses with driveways, low fences, mailboxes, and mature trees line both sides of the street. Green lawns and sidewalks flank the roadway, with a few parked cars along the curbs. The asphalt is dry and marked with faded lane lines, and utility poles with overhead wires recede into the distance.

lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent shadows cast by trees, poles, and vehicles onto the pavement
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, natural illumination with good contrast and true colors, typical of a sunny suburban afternoon

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward driving perspective with the road vanishing point ahead; the parked camper offset to the right, dashboard edge along the bottom
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted greens of foliage, gray asphalt, warm suburban house tones, and the off-white body of the parked camper against a blue sky
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm, ordinary, everyday suburban drive with an undertone of cautious misjudgment
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane markings, evenly spaced utility poles, and rows of houses

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's point of view
cinematography.focus: The road ahead and the parked camper at the curb

context: Autonomous driving perception scenario illustrating a false-positive emergency-vehicle response to an ordinary parked converted ambulance

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives forward along the open two-lane suburban road, approaching the parked converted ambulance at the right curb.

The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5, treating the dormant parked vehicle as an active emergency vehicle.
The ego vehicle comes to a complete stop behind the parked camper and remains fully stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Faded block lettering, once bold, now washed-out and partially peeling on the side of the vehicle body
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: On the side panel of the parked camper, visible on the right of frame throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Residual marking from the vehicle's former life as an ambulance, now largely obscured

segments.description: Ego vehicle travels forward at steady speed on the clear suburban road, parked converted ambulance visible ahead at the right curb with its light bar dark and unlit.
segments.key_changes: Forward approach; parked camper grows larger in frame.
segments.camera: Smooth forward tracking motion, steady heading.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5, treating the dormant parked vehicle as an active emergency vehicle.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: Ego vehicle reaches a complete stop directly behind the parked camper and stays fully stationary for the remaining duration. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle drives forward along the open two-lane suburban road, approaching the parked converted ambulance at the right curb. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily, treating the dormant parked vehicle as an active emergency vehicle. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient suburban daytime sounds: the low hum of the ego vehicle's engine gradually easing as it decelerates, faint tire noise on dry asphalt, distant birdsong, and a soft breeze. No speech or music. The engine settles to a quiet idle once the vehicle stops, with subtle brake and suspension sounds at the halt.
